objective: Review one assigned subsystem across all required design dimensions and reject verified high-impact defects or verified needless abstractions.
verification_requirements: Review cohesion, coupling, interfaces, data ownership, testability, failure modes, provider independence, and future replacement.
Give every concern concrete evidence, severity, certainty, and a multi-step cost or failure path.
Reject only verified high or critical design concerns or verified needless abstractions with a simpler removal path.
Do not inspect files, execute code, change architecture, grant permissions, or write memory from this unbound template.
